# VRChat sub-actions

## Get avatar parameter

Finds out a parameter's value that VRChat last reported, so later steps can use it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Parameter** | The parameter's name exactly as in your avatar. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vrchat.value%` | Its value |
| `%vrchat.avatarId%` | The avatar you are wearing |

<small>Type id: `vrchat.getParameter`</small>

## Send chatbox message

Shows text in the chatbox above your avatar in VRChat. Everyone in your world can see it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Text** | What to show. Longer than 144 characters is cut off. |
| **Show it right away (skip the keyboard)** | Shows it straight away. Untick to put it in your keyboard so you can send it yourself. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Play the notification sound** | Plays VRChat's little notification sound. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vrchat.chatbox%` | The text that was shown |

<small>Type id: `vrchat.chatbox`</small>

## Set avatar parameter

Changes one of your avatar's parameters, for example to turn on a hat or change your outfit when someone redeems a reward.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Parameter** | The parameter's name exactly as in your avatar (capital letters matter). |
| **Type** | The kind of parameter: Bool is on/off, Int is a whole number, Float is a number from -1 to 1. It must match your avatar. Options: Bool (on/off), Int (whole number 0-255), Float (number from -1 to 1). Starts as: `Bool (on/off)`. |
| **Value** | The new value. For Bool you can also type toggle to flip it. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vrchat.value%` | The value that was sent |

<small>Type id: `vrchat.setParameter`</small>

## Show typing bubble

Shows or hides the "typing..." bubble above your avatar.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Show it** | Tick to show it, untick to hide it. Starts as: `true`. |

<small>Type id: `vrchat.typing`</small>
